title: Renglo semantic dictionary
description: The shared vocabulary a Renglo ontology or schema cites. Property names are a closed set. The document id is name + '.' + version, such as animals.1.0.0. A term id is name + '.' + the term key, such as animals.mammal. Term ids are unique. A term with inverse is a relationship: inverse is the id of another term in this dictionary, and the two terms name each other. A term may be its own inverse.

id.description: name.version. This is the string an ontology or a schema puts in dictionaries. The server fills it on write.

name.description: Dictionary name. A letter followed by letters, digits, underscores, or dots.

description.description: What this vocabulary covers. May be empty on a new draft.

terms.description: Terms keyed by a lowercase name. The key is the part of the term id after the dictionary name.

version.description: x.y.z while the dictionary is a draft. A semantic version after publish.

status.description: draft, final, or deprecated. This is the document status. A term has its own status.

origin.description: URI of the dictionary this copy was cloned from. Empty when the dictionary was created here.

id.description: name.key, where key is this term's property name in terms.

description.description: What the term means, independent of any one schema or ontology.

inverse.description: Term id of the relationship that reverses this one. Omit it on a term that is not a relationship. The other term's inverse is this term's id.

external_mappings.description: External names that mean this term. Each name appears once.

status.description: active or deprecated. Deprecating a term is a major change of the dictionary.

belongs_to.label: Belongs to
belongs_to.description: The ingredient is part of the dish.
